versions.name: RXV2-0.9.665-check-goblin
versions.notes: Vibration check, corrected by the Goblin's own flight: it advised 'set the rotor-speed notches to high' for a once-per-rev that Rotorflight's NORMAL preset already notches - the change would have done nothing. The check now knows what each preset really notches (rpmFilterPreset[] in rpm_filter.c: main harmonics 1-2-4 low, 1-4 normal, 1-6 high, tail 1 / 1-2 / 1-2, plus the main motor) and only advises a preset that genuinely adds the harmonic; a strong once-per-rev is reported as blade tracking and balance, with no filter button. Attenuation is measured over a wider window so a narrow rotor notch is not mistaken for a useless one. The 90-second Goblin flight is now a regression fixture (dev/goblin_flight_*.json). Includes 0.9.664.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.664-check-window
versions.notes: Vibration check reads the last 12 MB of the black box (the newest flight or two) instead of the whole memory, widening itself if that holds no log, and shows a time remaining; the page says so and offers Erase. Measured throughput 62-66 kB/s.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.663-check-fast
versions.notes: Vibration check: the armed gate no longer aborts the check before the flight controller has answered (and never forces the shared armed flag every page reads); reads 4096-byte chunks where the FC allows, through the check's own PSRAM buffer.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.662-vibration-check-safe
versions.notes: Vibration check made safe before real flying (review + Malcolm's rules): the check owns the MSP link - every other sender stands down and /api/msp answers 503; arming is re-asked every second over USB; MSP 70 flag bits corrected (READY=1, SUPPORTED=2 - the recorder page had them the other way round too); a late reply re-arms instead of re-sending; PSRAM only; float maths. Decoder: the two TAG8_8SVB groups (sensors / temperatures) never merge, a header straight after a truncated log is recognised, time predictors in wrapping arithmetic, no 4.8 kB stack temporary. Analyser keeps the newest log that FLEW (a bench arm after landing no longer replaces the flight). Page: Apply is bounded (Lowpass 1 never below 60 and never raised, fixed notches 80-1000 Hz, dynamic notches 0-8), refused while armed or the rotor turns or on an unverified Rotorflight, read back and compared, Undo, ONE change per flight; filter advice only when the log has Gyro raw + Gyro + Head speed. Includes 0.9.661.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.661-vibration-check
versions.notes: VIBRATION CHECK: the receiver (or dongle) reads the flight controller's black box over the USB cable (MSP 70/71, 512-byte chunks, one per loop pass), decodes Rotorflight 4.6's log format on the fly (src/BlackboxDecode.h, spec in BLACKBOX-FORMAT.md), accumulates Welch spectra of the gyro before and after the filters plus a head-speed-locked order spectrum, and the new page (Flight recorder → Vibration check, or the full list) names the lines (rotor, blades, motor, tail, or something loose), says in one line which filter to change and applies it (rotor-speed notch preset, lowest rotor frequency, fixed notch 1/2, dynamic notches, Lowpass 1). USB only, transmitter off, disarmed; /api/msp answers 503 while it runs; the heartbeat and TX-param machine stand down. Host-tested on synthetic logs (dev/bbcheck_test.sh). Includes 0.9.660.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.660-two-wires-card
versions.notes: Before you start opens with 'First, get a short USB-C data cable': connect both wires - the lead flies and carries the everyday pages, the USB cable is the configurator's own channel (every setting, Ports, In-flight adjustments, command line, factory reset, black box); about 12 cm, right-angled if possible, must carry data. Without it the computer does the port/CRSF/telemetry and the USB-only pages stay out of reach. Includes 0.9.659.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.659-usb-first-time
versions.notes: Before you start: a computer only to flash the firmware; with the USB cable the Ports page does the rest - choosing 'receiver' for a port now also switches on serial receiver mode and telemetry (features 3 + 10, read-modify-write) in the same Save, so a brand-new flight controller never needs the configurator's Receiver tab. Configurator steps kept as the no-cable alternative. New-heli wizard step reworded. Includes 0.9.658.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.658-help-corner
versions.notes: The ? and search circles sit 2.6em further in from the top-right corner, clear of the app's small X on the demo and review screens (iPad mis-taps). Includes 0.9.657.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.657-cable
versions.notes: Help (Rotorflight menu, Setup's USB socket, every Ways-to-connect footer): buy a SHORT USB-C cable, about 12 cm, right-angled at the flight controller if you can, and make sure it is a data cable - many short leads only charge. Includes 0.9.656.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.656-two-wires
versions.notes: Help: 'Two wires, everything' - the receiver lead carries flying and the everyday pages; the USB-C cable adds the configurator's own channel (every setting, any size, command line, ports, factory reset, black box); a transmitter's Lua scripts have only the slow 320-byte CRSF tunnel. Said on the Rotorflight menu help and in every help screen's Ways to connect, which no longer calls the app Apple-only. Includes 0.9.655.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.655-filters
versions.notes: New Filters page (Rotorflight's Filters tab): gyro lowpass 1 and 2 (type and cutoff), rotor-speed (RPM) notch preset and lowest frequency, dynamic notches (count, width, range) and the two fixed notches; read-modify-write of MSP 92/93, takes effect at once. The help explains what each filter does and how to read the Blackbox Explorer's frequency view to see which filter is needed. Includes 0.9.654.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.654-review-fixes
versions.notes: From a critical pass over the day's work: In-flight adjustments never switches flight-controller banks while the transmitter is on (the boxes fill only for the bank in use; flip the switch for another); a Remove whose save fails reloads the page from the flight controller and says 'Not removed'; Save shows 'Writing line N of 43'; a receiver whose line to the flight controller carries no MSP (SBUS, IBUS, PPM, or FC telemetry off) answers 'needs the USB cable' instead of a timeout; the Ports warning covers the dongle's own port. Includes 0.9.653.
